guide.title: Waste Analyzer User Guide
guide.subtitle: Follow these practical steps to analyze agricultural waste and discover its market value instantly.
guide.dontShowAgain: Do not show automatically when opening this page

step1.title: Prepare Agricultural Waste Photo
step1.desc: Take a photo of crop residue or waste (such as straw, husk, palm EFB, bagasse, or manure) in good lighting with the object clearly in focus.

step2.title: Upload Image or Choose Sample
step2.desc: Drag and drop an image into the upload area, click browse to select a file from your device, or click 1-click test on one of the ready-to-use waste samples.

step3.title: AI Vision Analyzes Automatically
step3.desc: Gemini AI Vision inspects waste characteristics: identifying type, confidence score, visual condition, and circular processing potential.

step4.title: Get Valuation & Start Selling
step4.desc: Check the estimated market price range per ton and demand opportunities, then click Sell Now to offer your waste directly to the circular marketplace.
